sentences.text:
This miscellaneous appeal by claimant under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is arising out of the Award dated 20.03.2013 passed by Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal,
Datia (hereinafter it would be referred to as "the Claims Tribunal") in Claim Case No. 35 of 2012 on account of inadequacy of compensation and seeking enhancement of compensation amount.
2.
The date of accident, negligence and issue of liability are not in dispute, however, the findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal in this regard are also not in question.

3. As per the findings of the Claims Tribunal, the Tribunal has awarded a total compensation of Rs.1,00,600/- along with interest from filing of the claim petition till its realisation in favour of the claimant.

4. Learned counsel for the appellant/claimant submitted that the Claims NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-GWL:17225 2 MA-739-2013 Tribunal has committed an error in not awarding just and proper amount of compensation in the case and the amount awarded by the Claims Tribunal is on the lower side.

It is further submitted that claimant received so many injures in the alleged incident and she was unable to do any work and also spent near about Rs.2,00,000/- in her treatment,
hence, prayed for enhancement of compensation.
@ Phoola vs Neha Jain on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53421317/
1 5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the insurance company contended that the amount awarded by the Claims Tribunal is just and proper and needs no enhancement.
He supported the findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal and prays for dismissal of the appeal.

6. Heard learned counsel for the appellant and perused of the record.
7.

After hearing learned counsel for the appellant, perusal of the record and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, more particularly the age as well as injuries sustained by the claimant in the alleged incident, it shall be appropriate to enhance the amount.

Accordingly, Rs.50,000/- in addition to the amount as awarded by the Claims Tribunal is enhanced, which shall carry interest at the same rate awarded by the Tribunal in its award from date of filing the application in the Tribunal.
8. With aforesaid, the miscellaneous appeal is allowed and disposed of.

(HIRDESH) JUDGE *AVI*
